title: 2005 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mitsubishi) and Cyril Despres (KTM)
summary: The 2005 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its African era: 14 stage towns and bivouacs through Spain, Morocco, Mauritania, Mali, Senegal. Winners — Cars: Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mitsubishi); Bikes: Cyril Despres (KTM); Trucks: Firdaus Kabirov / Aydar Belyaev / Andrey Mokeev (Kamaz).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
